concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-quickstart-guide-support]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms support quickstart assigning user-facing support to the platform and Adyen escalation to its business, with KYC/payout troubleshooting and ticket routes; examples and typical timing are not response or financial-outcome guarantees.
warnings: The first-/second-/third-line structure is explicitly illustrative; do not convert it into a mandated organization or a guaranteed Adyen response. The FAQ's account-holder activation suggestion is conditional and does not prove verification or payout capability.
